name: daily-planner
title: Daily Planner
description: Planning workspace: a guided chat produces a persisted, editable day plan (Focus Sessions + to-dos), with weekly objectives, history search and day time-travel. Full module-as-plugin: seven tools, the persona knowledge doc, and the real two-pane page.

knowledge.purpose: the operator timezone + workweek days that anchor 'today' and the week's Sunday

tables.name: plugin_daily_planner_plans
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_daily_planner_plans (date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, plan TEXT NOT NULL, mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'wing_it', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

tables.name: plugin_daily_planner_objectives
tables.ddl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plugin_daily_planner_objectives (week_start TEXT PRIMARY KEY, objectives TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

def.name: read_daily_plan
def.description: Read one day's plan (schedule blocks + to-dos). date is YYYY-MM-DD, default today. Call this before editing a day or to see what is already planned.

def.name: save_daily_plan
def.description: Write (or replace) a day's plan — this is what fills the plan panel. schedule = time blocks [{start:'HH:MM', end:'HH:MM', title, deliverable, focus}]. Mark each ~2-hour FOCUS SESSION block focus:true (the operator says how many fit in a day) — those are the day's backbone; supporting blocks are focus:false. todos = [{text, priority, star}], star:true for the extra-important few. mode 'strategic' (aligned to the week's objectives, set weekly_ref = that week's Sunday) or 'wing_it'. date defaults to today. Replaces the whole plan; use update_daily_plan to change part of one.

summary.description: one line on what this day is about

weekly_ref.description: the aligned week's Sunday (YYYY-MM-DD), strategic mode

schedule.description: time blocks, each with a concrete deliverable

def.name: update_daily_plan
def.description: Edit part of a day's plan during the day (tick a block or to-do done, add a to-do, shift the schedule). Pass ONLY the keys you are changing; everything else is kept as-is. date defaults to today.

def.name: search_daily_plans
def.description: Search past daily plans by text (matches the summary, the to-dos and the blocks). Use it to recall or reuse an earlier day. An empty query returns the most recent plans.

def.name: list_recent_plans
def.description: The most recent PAST daily plans, strictly before today (default the last 3). Call it at the start of planning to surface unfinished priorities and ask the operator what happened to each (done / carry over / drop).

def.name: read_weekly_objectives
def.description: Read a week's strategic objectives. week_start is that week's Sunday (YYYY-MM-DD), or pass any `date` to have its workweek anchored for you; default is the current week. Read this in strategic mode before planning a day so the day points at the week.

week_start.description: the week's Sunday, YYYY-MM-DD; default this week

date.description: any day (YYYY-MM-DD) — its workweek is anchored server-side

def.name: set_weekly_objectives
def.description: Set a week's strategic objectives — the 2-4 outcomes that move the business in the intended direction. objectives is a list of short outcome strings (or {text, done} objects) and REPLACES the week's list. week_start defaults to the current week's Sunday.

week_start.description: the week's Sunday, YYYY-MM-DD; default this week
